gate_a_calibration.methodology: Full-sample OOS calibration on 1,752 Top-5 European holdout matches across 4 markets.

forward_tactic_baseline.failure_reason: Public action bias in retail odds causes negative CLV penalty on first-half overs (I1+, I2+).

reverse_tactic_alpha.methodology: Multi-League Reverse Tactic fading retail overs, backing Under 1.5 HT (I 0-1), 0-0 HT (I 0), and Draw HT (HT X) with genuine Mozzart quotes.

governance_rationale: APPROVED_PRODUCTION: The Reverse Tactic successfully cleared all three institutional validation gates. Calibration (Gate A), Market Alpha / Positive CLV (Gate B), and Economic Yield (Gate C) were verified out-of-sample on the untouched 2024/25 Top-5 European holdout.
